image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a marine mollusk, specifically a chiton, clinging to a rocky substrate. The organism has an elongated, oval shape with a rough, brownish-grey leathery girdle surrounding a central series of eight overlapping, reddish-brown calcareous plates. The texture appears wet and armored. The background consists of out-of-focus pebbles and sand.
